output: You're right that the monthly management pack is where spreadsheets tend to hang on, and that most finance workflows will keep Excel in some form. Our spreadsheet add-in handles two-way refresh and write-back, so your team can keep working in the sheets they know while the data stays current, and our formatted report templates cover the common board and management layouts. Highly custom layouts may still be finished in a spreadsheet, and we'd be upfront about that. For proof, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: finance team replaced a manual monthly export with add-in refresh. If it would help, I'd suggest a short working session where we rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports together, so you can see where the add-in fits and where it doesn't.
